description: A well-stocked general store at The Crossroads, selling supplies useful in any world.

items.name: Rope
items.description: 50 feet of sturdy rope. Useful for climbing, tying, or escaping.

items.name: Torch
items.description: Provides light in dark places for about an hour

items.name: Rations
items.description: A day's worth of travel food. Keeps well.

items.name: Traveler's Pack
items.description: A sturdy backpack with extra pockets

items.name: Small Bone Treats
items.description: A bag of tasty treats for your companion. +5 loyalty

items.name: Medium Bone Treats
items.description: A bag of quality treats for your companion. +7 loyalty

items.name: Large Bone Treats
items.description: Premium treats that companions love! +10 loyalty

items.name: Arrows
items.description: A quiver of 20 arrows for hunting and combat

items.name: Bandages
items.description: Stops bleeding and heals 10 HP over time

items.name: World Map
items.description: A map showing the portals at The Crossroads and the basics of each world

items.name: Campfire Kit
items.description: Everything needed to start a safe campfire

special_dialogue.browse: Take your time looking around! I've got supplies from all corners of existence.
special_dialogue.purchase: Excellent choice! That'll serve you well on your adventures.
special_dialogue.sell: Hmm, let me take a look at what you've got... *examines item* I can give you a fair price for this.
special_dialogue.no_gold: Ah, a bit short on coin? No worries - come back when you've earned some on your adventures!
special_dialogue.farewell: Safe travels through the portals, friend! Come back anytime!
